page_label: 说　明　书 9/17 页

paragraphs.zh: 向三氟乙醇醇钾中加入200mL  THF，搅拌溶解后控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐(98.3％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应3h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至2，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物33.0g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为98.2％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率93.5％。
paragraphs.en: 200 mL of THF was added to the potassium trifluoroethoxide; after stirring to dissolve, the kettle temperature was controlled at 5 C, and the potassium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.3％, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total addition time of 3 h; after addition was complete the mixture was held at temperature and reacted for 3 h. When the reaction was complete, the solvent was removed under reduced pressure, 120 mL of water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 2; then filtration, water rinsing and drying gave 33.0 g of product. HPLC assay gave a content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid of 98.2％, and a two-step reaction yield of 93.5％ based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: Continuation of Example 5, which began on the previous page. 三氟乙醇醇钾 is literally 'potassium trifluoroethanol alkoxide', i.e. potassium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide. The Chinese writes the ether product as 2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸, i.e. the trifluoroethoxy group is on the 3-methyl, but the name as written places the parenthesis before 甲基 rather than using the -氧甲基 form; translated literally.

paragraphs.en: (1) Preparation of the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: 苯甲酸盐 is the generic 'benzoate salt'; the cation is not named here, though the drawing that follows shows the potassium salt.
Marker carries no prose; it labels the reaction scheme drawn to its right. See drawings[0].

paragraphs.zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇350mL，开动搅拌，室温下将6.6g氢氧化钾(85％，0.1mol)滴入其中，待氢氧化钾分散均匀后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应7h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐归一含量为97.3％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
paragraphs.en: 350 mL of tert-butanol was added to the reaction flask and stirring was started; at room temperature 6.6 g of potassium hydroxide (85％, 0.1 mol) was added dropwise into it, and after the potassium hydroxide had dispersed uniformly the kettle temperature was controlled at 25 C, and 34.8 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98％, 0.1 mol) was poured into the kettle to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis reaction; the reaction was slightly exothermic, the kettle temperature was controlled at 25 C, and the reaction ran for 7 h. When the reaction had finished, in-process liquid chromatography gave a normalised content of potassium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate of 97.3％; the solvent was stripped off completely under reduced pressure and the material was used directly in the subsequent etherification reaction.
paragraphs.notes: 叔丁醇 is tert-butanol. 碱解 is literally 'alkaline decomposition', here saponification/hydrolysis of the methyl ester. 归一含量 is the area-normalised (100％ area) HPLC content.

paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入70mLDMF、12.6g三氟乙醇(99％，0.125mol)和26.1g氢氧化钾溶液(30％，0.14mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐(97.3％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为2h，加毕保温反应4h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至2，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.4g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为96.0％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率89.3％。
paragraphs.en: 70 mL of DMF, 12.6 g of trifluoroethanol (99％, 0.125 mol) and 26.1 g of potassium hydroxide solution (30％, 0.14 mol) were added to the reaction kettle, stirring was started, the kettle temperature was controlled at 5 C, and the potassium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (97.3％, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total addition time of 2 h; after addition was complete the mixture was held at temperature and reacted for 4 h. When the reaction was complete, the solvent was removed under reduced pressure, 120 mL of water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 2; then filtration, water rinsing and drying gave 32.4 g of product. HPLC assay gave a content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid of 96.0％, and a two-step reaction yield of 89.3％ based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: Printed as 70mLDMF with no separator between the volume and the solvent name, as transcribed. The PDF text layer renders this paragraph's percentages as '97 .3％' and '0 .1mol' with a stray space; the printed page shows no such space, so the image reading 97.3％ / 0.1mol is used.

paragraphs.en: (1) Preparation of the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: This paragraph announces a reaction equation, but no drawing follows it on this page; the remainder of the page below this line is blank apart from the page number. The scheme it introduces must be on the next page.

drawings.notes: Step (1) of Example 6: saponification of the methyl ester to the potassium carboxylate. Both rings are drawn as a hexagon with three internal double bonds (Kekule benzene). The carboxylate is drawn as K-O-C(=O)- with an explicit K-O single bond, i.e. as a covalent line rather than as separated ions; the SMILES records it as the potassium salt. Only KOH is written above the arrow, and nothing below it.

Step (2) of Example 6: etherification of the benzylic bromide with trifluoroethanol/KOH, then acidification with HCl to free the carboxylic acid. The two reagents above the arrow are separated by a full-width Chinese enumeration comma, printed as CF3CH2OH、KOH. HCl sits alone below the arrow. The side chain on C3 of the product is drawn as ring-CH2-O-CH2-CF3, with the O drawn as an explicit atom label between the two CH2 vertices; the product acid is drawn as HO-C(=O)-.
